note: The main banks: Butterfield, HSBC Bermuda and Clarien Bank, Bermuda's three retail banks that issue personal credit cards. Butterfield's Bermuda retail schedule of charges (the January 2026 schedule, last updated 1 December 2025), read in full: its six personal cards, each with its primary card's annual fee and interest rate, its cash advance charge (a share of the advance, at least $5), a minimum payment of 3.5% with a $10 floor, the $50 late payment and $40 NSF handling fees, and its penalty rate for an account 60 days or more delinquent, the rate 'increases by 5% over current rate', read as five percentage points and written so (the 60 days and the six months' good standing before it reverts aren't modelled). The schedule's $40 over-limit fee isn't written: Clarien's fee page says that, through regulatory changes from 25 March 2026, card transactions over the limit are declined and no over-limit fee is charged, and Butterfield's schedule predates that. Its US cross-border fee (30 to 60 basis points on US transactions) isn't modelled; the schedule states no fee on other currencies. Clarien Bank's fee schedule (effective 8 November 2024, its page read 30 October 2026): its Visa Platinum ($85), Visa Platinum Private ($150, for Clarien+ and private banking clients) and Visa Infinite Private ($300, for private banking clients; conditions the game doesn't check), each issued in Bermuda or US dollars and written in Bermuda dollars, at 21.00% on purchases and 22.75% on cash advances, a cash advance fee of 2.50% (at least $5), a 3% foreign currency conversion fee on non-US, non-Bermuda spending (the 30 basis point US cross-border fee isn't modelled), a minimum payment of 3.5% with a $10 floor, a $50 late fee, and a penalty rate 5% higher for six months once 60 days delinquent (written as 26.00%). Its Visa Infinite Corporate isn't written. HSBC Bermuda's credit cards page and its banking fees schedule (read 30 October 2026): its six personal cards, the Premier Mastercard Black ($350 a year, waived with $1,000,000 in savings or investments, written as a balance, or $100,000 spent a year), Premier Mastercard and Premier BermudaCard Mastercard (no annual fee; Premier customers only, a condition the game doesn't check), Visa Gold ($100), BermudaCard ($60) and Visa Classic ($85), all at 20.95% a year, the BermudaCards in Bermuda dollars and the others in US dollars, with a minimum payment of 5%, a cash advance fee of 2.5% (at least $2.50), a $50 late fee, and a 2% foreign currency conversion fee on the US dollar cards (the 0.6% US cross-border fee isn't modelled; the BermudaCards are for use in Bermuda only). The fee schedule says no penalty rate is charged. Its Advance Mastercard, in the fee schedule but not on the cards page, and its business card aren't written. This file kept Butterfield's Mastercard Standard or Visa Classic and Clarien's Visa Platinum, read on 29 October 2026; Clarien's 22.75% cash advance rate, left out then, is written now.
